title: FGC 616: Engine and Gas Turbine-Powered Equipment and Appliances
officialText:
616.1 Powered equipment.

Permanently installed equipment powered by internal combustion engines and turbines shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and NFPA 37. Stationary engine generator assemblies shall meet the requirements of UL 2200.

616.2 Gas supply connection.

Equipment powered by internal combustion engines and turbines shall not be rigidly connected to the gas supply piping.
